def main():
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.read())
    if n == 1:
        print(1)
        return
    # The minimal number of divisors is achieved when p(j) = j + 1 if j is odd, else j - 1
    # But for n=2, p=[2,1] works (divisors: 1,2)
    # For n=3, p=[1,3,2] works (divisors: 1,3)
    # For n=4, p=[2,1,4,3] works (divisors: 1,2,4)
    # General pattern: swap adjacent pairs to minimize divisors
    p = [0] * (n + 1)
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        if j % 2 == 1:
            p[j] = j + 1 if j + 1 <= n else j - 1
        else:
            p[j] = j - 1
    # Handle edge cases where n is even or odd
    if n % 2 == 0:
        for j in range(1, n + 1, 2):
            p[j] = j + 1
            p[j + 1] = j
    else:
        for j in range(1, n, 2):
            p[j] = j + 1
            p[j + 1] = j
        p[n] = n
    # Output the permutation
    print(' '.join(map(str, p[1:n+1])))

main()
